messages:
devon: Following the cache-eviction postmortem, we need an actionable runbook and short remediation plays so oncall can act in <15m. I want owners for: runbook edits, quick shell commands, pre-deploy guard, and alert tuning. Goal: cut repeated evictions and make incidents surgical. Please claim.

jen_sre: I can take the runbook text and the short CLI snippets. I'll focus on a 1-page 'fast triage' at the top for oncall.

maria_pm: I want to own the regression criteria and acceptance tests so we don't revert the wrong things. Will also produce the customer-facing note for CS.

chris_platform: I'll handle platform changes: a simple admission webhook to block huge batch sizes and an extra /healthz?cache check. Prototype by mid-week.

devon: Good. Quick principles: 1) one-page top-level play 2) exact commands, copy-paste friendly 3) escalation ladder with explicit times 4) alert thresholds that map to pages and runbook steps.

jen_sre: Draft fast-triage bullets I'll add to runbook: - confirm eviction spike - identify affected models/pods - run soft-fallback routing - check recent deploys/compiles - decide rollback or scale.

jen_sre: CLI snippets for the top of the playbook (to paste into Slack/terminal):
```
# tail eviction lines (last 20m)
kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n inference --since=20m | grep -i eviction | tail -n 200

# list pods by eviction count (approx via restart count)
kubectl get pods -n inference -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,RESTARTS:.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount --sort-by='.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount'

# check recent model revisions and who deployed
redwood-ctl deployments list --since 2h --namespace inference
```

chris_platform: Add a quick HTTP sanity check to run during triage: `curl -fsS https://runtime.internal/healthz?cache=stats` which returns JSON with eviction_rate and kv_hit_ratio. I'll add it to the health endpoint PR.

devon: Proposed escalation path: detection -> page oncall (0-5m) -> oncall escalates to senior runtime (10m) -> eng-lead (25m) -> infra-pager (60m). Also require incident doc entry within 10m and attach logs. Any objections?

maria_pm: That timeline works. Also include a temporary routing step: switch model routing to a compatible fallback profile before rolling back heavy changes. We'll add exact API call in the runbook.

jen_sre: Fallback routing example to include: `curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/admin/routing -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"policy":"fallback-low-ram","selector":"model:xyz"}'` (will redact token in docs).

opsbot: Created issue <https://tracker.redwood.local/RED-4950|RED-4950> "Runbook: fast-triage + playbook snippets" and assigned jen_sre.

devon: Owners & due dates for sprint: jen_sre (runbook + snippets) - 48h; chris_platform (webhook + health endpoint) - 5 working days; maria_pm (QA & comms) - 72h; ian_product (customer comm approvals) - 72h. I will create the sprint ticket bundle after owners confirm.

chris_platform: Claiming chris_platform. Will open a draft PR for the webhook and health path tomorrow and link here.

jen_sre: Claiming jen_sre. I'll post the one-page fast-triage and full runbook diff in #runbooks when done.

maria_pm: Claiming maria_pm. Will add regression tests (load tests + synthetic eviction scenarios) and acceptance criteria.

ian_product: I'll coordinate on the comms and vendor/customer notifications if we enable fallback.

devon: On recurring pattern detection: telemetry shows many incidents tie to large batch-size changes + cold nodes. Let's add a weekly report and an automated alert rule: if eviction_rate by model rises >0.01 (1%) over 5m AND batch_size > 1024 in deployment config, create a warning and block auto-deploys. Opsbot, can you create a monitor?

opsbot: Monitor created: `eviction_rate_model > 0.01 over 5m AND deployment_batch_size > 1024` -> creates ticket RED-4956 and notifies infra-team. Link <https://monitoring.redwood.local/alerts/RED-4956|RED-4956>.

jen_sre: Add a 'fast rollback' play that we can run if the fallback doesn't hold. Commands to include in runbook: `redwood-ctl releases rollback --model MODEL --release-id RELEASE --force-verify` and `kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime -n inference`. Include a pre-check that traffic is draining.

devon: Also add a short script snippet we can run to flip routing and confirm user-facing latency is stable before sending CS msg. Keep messaging template short: one sentence + ETA. ian_product, can you draft that message?

ian_product: Will draft a 2-line customer note and an FAQ entry for the runbook.

devon: OK. Let's reconvene in 72 hours in this thread to close the runbook and mark tickets ready for sprint. If anything blocks, call me or @chris_platform directly. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
